logs.text: My little brother, Jimbo, is no longer suffering from diarrhea.
Mother nature moved her body in a dangerous cyclone through Zimbabwe. Most evacuated, however 11 deaths have been confirmed.

scenarios.Title: October 14th
scenarios.Body:
A weirdo you work with is a self-professed entomophage, meaning a person who likes to eat insects. He informs you that today is National Chocolate-Covered Insect Day and offers you a sampling of his favorite homemade chocolate treats.

What will you choose?

logs.text: I ate a chocolate-covered scorpion on National Chocolate-Covered Insect Day.
Kuwait's space program wins the race to land a human on Venus.

scenarios.Title: Insult
scenarios.Body:
You just observed a firearms activist call your mother foolhardy!

What will you do?

logs.text: I observed a firearms activist call my mother foolhardy! I forgave him.
Recently, I've been pondering how a sloppy joe is really just a chili sandwich.

scenarios.Title: Duffle Bag
scenarios.Body:
While on your walk, you find a duffle bag.

What will you do?

logs.text: I turned in a duffle bag that I found.
My little brother, Jimbo, married Kaelynn Grump, a 30-year old real estate agent.

scenarios.Title: Whale Sashimi
scenarios.Body:
Some of your friends are eating whale sashimi.

Will you join them?

scenarios.Title: Casino
scenarios.Body:
Some of your friends are going to a local casino called Rosebud Casino Resort.

Will you join them?
_choices: No, I don't feel like it

logs.text: I went with some friends to Rosebud Casino Resort.
